description.zh: 需要幂等场景必填。UUID生成的字符串。此字段用于幂等，多次调用传入同样的值，会返回第一次的结果。调用后如果返回了结果，可以解析到退款订单编号，代表调用成功。
description.en: This parameter is required for scenarios that need idempotence. The UUID that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

description.zh: 退订场景必填。1：标识立即释放。0：标识先停机，根据停机策略停机。仅部分商品支持。默认都是立即释放。
description.en: This parameter is required for unsubscription scenarios. Valid values: 1 and 0. A value of 1 specifies that the instance is immediately released. A value of 0 specifies that the instance is shut down based on the shutdown policy. This parameter is supported only for specified services. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 退订场景必填，实例id，非自定义名称。
description.en: The ID of the instance. This parameter is required for unsubscription scenarios. Do not specify a custom name for this parameter.

description.zh: 退订场景必填，产品code。如果调用后错误码提示产品不支持，可提交工单申请云产品允许开通此功能。
description.en: The code of the service. This parameter is required for unsubscription scenarios.

description.zh: 退订场景必填，产品类型，无特殊说明传入空字符串。在调试工具上，无需手动输入，鼠标放到输入框上，会弹出"输入空字符串"的按钮，点击此按钮即可。通过代码发起退订时，传入英文字符下的空字符串 ""。
description.en: The type of the service. This parameter is required for unsubscription scenarios. Unless otherwise specified, set this parameter to an empty string.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi refund-instance --client-token 793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494 --immediately-release 1 --product-code ecs --instance-id i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000 --product-type '空字符串' --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi RefundInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ImmediatelyRelease 1 --ProductCode ecs --InstanceId 'i-bp1etb69sqxgl40000000' --ProductType '空字符串' --ClientToken '793F021C-B589-1225-82A9-99232AEBE494'
